scope: Balakrushna Das's early film music credits; a bounded original-programme lead retained for the next radio/literature cycle.

sources.inspection: Fresh direct web text and linked promotional image.
sources.finding: Lists Balakrushna Das and Ranjit Roy together under Music; H.M.V. separately under background music and orchestra. The linked image contains no music-credit names.
sources.limits: No original title-credit frame or label. Division of music work and debut status remain unresolved.

sources.author: Bhaskar Parichha
sources.finding: Names Kedar Gouri (1954) as his first film as music director.
sources.limits: No underlying original credit cited for this assertion. Output totals, honours and superlatives not adopted. No public words added from this column.

sources.inspection: Fresh direct web text; HTML retrieval timed out, web text available.
sources.finding: Lists Balkrushna Das and Bhubaneswar Misra under Music; names three lyricists and four playback singers. The co-credit prevents assuming that the 1954 debut statement means first solo score.
sources.limits: Name spellings retained as source variants. The latter is a caution about inference, not proof that the column is wrong. No original music-credit roll inspected.

sources.type: Original-looking publicity and photograph hosted in family archive
sources.inspection: Retrieved gallery HTML and two linked images; viewed both complete images.
sources.finding: Publicity image carries Radha Pictures presentation and Chowdhury Bros release wording but no composer names. Second image is a group photograph, not a credit document.
sources.limits: Gallery caption identifies Gour Ghose, Ch. Balaram Das, Manoranjan Das and Parbati Ghose; identity/date/event not independently established. No music-production session inferred. Images retained for inspection only; no public reuse or public-domain claim.

sources.finding: Lists Dhire Samire under Radhagovind Pattnaik in Kedar Gouri, alongside two other tracks, with a 1954 Saregama phonogram line.
sources.limits: No original label image, song-level composer allocation or debut proof. A phonogram/catalogue year is not independent release-date evidence. No audition.

sources.inspection: Fresh web text names 1954 and Nitai Palit; page requires JavaScript.
sources.limits: No original credit roll or media inspected; limited access is not evidence of nonexistence.

approaches.route: Family archive credits and linked publicity
approaches.result: Two films' shared music metadata verified; three relevant original/composite images inspected, none contains music names.
Modern Saregama-distributed catalogue surfaced, not original 78 label or full credit.

approaches.route: Original booklet and institutional film discovery
approaches.result: No original booklet recovered; Indiancine.ma catalogue reached without original titles. Anvesha separately excluded a Bengali 1985 Sri Jagannath booklet.

decision.reason: The existing articles contain co-credits and no unsupported Kedar Gouri debut claim. New sources do not justify replacing them with a stronger statement.
decision.gap: Original early-film music-credit evidence remains unresolved after three distinct approaches; park until a precise credit frame, booklet or label appears.
no_inference: 1985 Bengali and 1950 Odia titles are the same film
